sections.heading: Identify the product family
paragraphs: A direct Tempest uses electrical heating; an indirect configuration transfers heat from an appropriate connected source. Products for renewables and restricted spaces have further model-specific requirements.

sections.heading: Why the distinction matters
paragraphs: Replacement should be based on heating compatibility, measured supply and available access. Do not choose a cylinder simply because its external diameter resembles the existing appliance. The discharge and expansion arrangements also need assessment.

sections.heading: A useful service enquiry
paragraphs: Provide the brand, exact model, serial label if readable, heating source and postcode. Note whether the issue is water temperature, flow, discharge or a connected controller. The business can discuss the enquiry and establish competence, scope and availability; this guide does not promise that every product or component can be repaired.

sections.heading: Independent information
paragraphs: Manufacturer sources below identify the equipment. This website is an independent service business and is not claiming an official partnership with the manufacturer. Parts compatibility and current supply must be checked for the installed model.

faqs.question: Can I replace a Tempest direct cylinder with an indirect version without other changes?
faqs.answer: Not automatically. The heating source, controls, supply and installation requirements differ; a competent survey must establish the appropriate configuration.
